DARV.talk.ROVER-ROVER.0-0.ancient: What brings the likes of you up here? Wanna take a look at my collection?
DARV.talk.ROVER-ROVER.0-1.char: I hope your things will be useful.
DARV.talk.ROVER-ROVER.0-2.ancient: Course! My collection never gonna let you down.
DARV.talk.ROVER-ROVER.1-0r.ancient: Did what I gave you last time come in handy?
DARV.talk.ROVER-ROVER.2-0.ancient: My new friend, haven't found your way back yet?
DARV.talk.ROVER-ROVER.2-1.char: I think I'll find the answer soon.
DARV.talk.ROVER-ROVER.2-2.ancient: If you ask me, that blind traveler is much more reliable than the Architect! Why don't you go ask her?
DARV.talk.ROVER-ROVER.3-0r.ancient: Take your pick, whatever helps you out.
NEOW.talk.ROVER-ROVER.0-1.char: I'm looking for a way back. Do you have any clues?
NONUPEIPE.talk.ROVER-ROVER.0-1.ancient:
Ah, a guest from afar!
Come in, receive my blessing.
NONUPEIPE.talk.ROVER-ROVER.1-0r.ancient: Those who wander here, feel free to rest for a while.
NONUPEIPE.talk.ROVER-ROVER.2-0.ancient: Do you think you can get anything out of the Architect? That one's insane!
OROBAS.talk.ROVER-ROVER.0-0.ancient:
Otherworlder?! Where from? How from?
Powerful aura! Amazing!
OROBAS.talk.ROVER-ROVER.0-1.char: That's the situation. I need to find a way back.
OROBAS.talk.ROVER-ROVER.0-2.ancient: The Architect! The Architect! Go talk to him!
OROBAS.talk.ROVER-ROVER.1-0r.ancient:
More stories! Found these for you!
Now tell more story!!
OROBAS.talk.ROVER-ROVER.2-0.char: Seeing your curiosity about everything reminds me of a group of people...
PAEL.talk.ROVER-ROVER.0-0.char: I didn't expect to find dragons in a place like this.
PAEL.talk.ROVER-ROVER.0-1.ancient: [thinky_dots]Judging by your look, you've seen beings like me elsewhere, haven't you?[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.ROVER-ROVER.1-0r.char: Youth is good, you just fall asleep.
PAEL.talk.ROVER-ROVER.2-0.ancient:
[thinky_dots]Welcome back, my friend.
What can I do for you this time?[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.ROVER-ROVER.2-1.char:
You're still as whole as when I first met you.
As if you never gave me a part of yourself.
PAEL.talk.ROVER-ROVER.2-2.ancient:
[thinky_dots]When you return, I will be replenished anew.
That’s what sleep does...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.ROVER-ROVER.0-0.ancient: YOU EMANATE A POWERFUL AURA, OTHERWORLDER. COME AND SPAR WITH ME!
TEZCATARA.talk.ROVER-ROVER.0-0.ancient: Oh my, what an [jitter][b]exotic[/b][/jitter] visitor! Who might you be, sweetie?
TEZCATARA.talk.ROVER-ROVER.0-1.char: That's the situation, I have to find a way back.
TEZCATARA.talk.ROVER-ROVER.0-2.ancient: Let me [jitter][b]illuminate[/b][/jitter] your path forward with flames.
TEZCATARA.talk.ROVER-ROVER.1-0r.ancient:
You and your friend are back again?
I’ve made [jitter][b]treats[/b][/jitter] for you!
TEZCATARA.talk.ROVER-ROVER.2-0.ancient: Welcome back, wanderer! Looks like those [jitter][b]monsters[/b][/jitter] outside are no match for you.
TEZCATARA.talk.ROVER-ROVER.2-1.char: There are also tricky ones among them, like... that Doormaker.
TEZCATARA.talk.ROVER-ROVER.2-2.ancient: But he didn't stop you either, did he.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ROVER-ROVER.0-1.char: Do you know how to leave this world?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ROVER-ROVER.1-0.char: Not going to tell me this time either?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ROVER-ROVER.1-1.ancie: Of course, you always help me collect some unexpected data.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ROVER-ROVER.1-2.char: You remind me of an organization.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ROVER-ROVER.2-0r.anci: Hmm? Shouldn't you have left already?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ROVER-ROVER.2-2r.anci: Go back where you came from...
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ROVER-ROVER.3-0r.anci: Don't bother me anymore, you're not welcome here anymore!
VAKUU.talk.ROVER-ROVER.0-0.ancient: An otherworlder? Within these accursed walls?
VAKUU.talk.ROVER-ROVER.0-2.ancient: Relax, I think we can make a little deal.
VAKUU.talk.ROVER-ROVER.1-0r.ancient: Just sign this contract, and maybe you can return to your sweet homeland.
VAKUU.talk.ROVER-ROVER.2-0.char: You again? Stop pushing your junk on me...
VAKUU.talk.ROVER-ROVER.2-1.ancient: That's hurtful. How can you call my [sine]carefully prepared[/sine] gifts junk?
VAKUU.talk.ROVER-ROVER.2-2.char: Do you even hear what you're saying?
VAKUU.title: Vakuu
